_comment: Baseline scores per (department, metric). Regenerated by the nightly Tier-4 continuous-eval job. The PR gate compares against this file — any regression > 0.05 on any metric within any department fails the build. Departments not yet observed are absent from `aggregates`; they get their baseline written on the first successful run against a live deployment. NOTE (post-reskin, 2026-09-09): `order-concierge` intentionally left empty. A trial run against the fresh deploy exercised all 30 golden rows end-to-end (29 got real responses) but three pre-existing issues meant the aggregates were unreliable: (1) the Foundry SDK evaluators still send `max_tokens` which the gpt-5.x deployments reject; (2) FOUNDRY_JUDGE_DEPLOYMENT env var isn't set so the triage rubric couldn't run; (3) work_order_completeness needs the raw resolution JSON but the /chat orchestrator returns prose. First follow-up PR should fix at least one of these and populate the baseline.
